%% DPRNet preamble for the Elsevier (elsarticle) submission build.
%% elsarticle.cls already loads: graphicx, amssymb, natbib, geometry, hyperref-ish
%% hooks. It does NOT load everything the DPRNet figures/tables need, so we add the
%% same extra packages used by the CVPR/MDPI builds here.
%% Rationale mirrors preamble.tex / preamble_mdpi.tex: the section/table/figure
%% sources are shared verbatim across all three builds, so their dependencies
%% (amsmath, booktabs, multirow, pifont, pgfplots/tikz, float [H], subcaption via
%% minipage) must all be satisfied by whichever preamble is active.

\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\usepackage{booktabs}    % Tables I--V rules
\usepackage{multirow}    % Table I (tab:main_comparison)
\usepackage{float}       % [H] placement used by the structure/plot figures and Table V
\usepackage{pifont}      % Table IV (\ding{51}/\ding{55} switches)
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{pgfplots}    % Fig.3/5/6 plots
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.16}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta,calc,fit,backgrounds,shapes.geometric} % Fig.1/Fig.2

%% Highlight colors for the DPR/TAB contribution in structure figures (Fig.1/Fig.2).
%% Kept identical to the CVPR/MDPI builds so the shared figure sources render the same.
\providecommand{\dprhl}{}
\definecolor{dprblue}{rgb}{0.21,0.49,0.74}
\definecolor{dpramber}{rgb}{0.83,0.55,0.20}
\definecolor{cvprblue}{rgb}{0.21,0.49,0.74}

%% Inline annotation helpers (disabled/no-op for submission; keep macros defined
%% so any stray \red/\todo in shared sources does not break the build).
\newcommand{\red}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\todo}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\TODO}[1]{}

%% hyperref last (elsarticle is compatible); light setup, no colored boxes for a
%% clean submission PDF.
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
